cells.gaps: The counts held are a Matola pilot, a Nampula incubator and the Machel Fidus Association's DiGi school project, which the education ministry joined only to expand it; no counted government programme for the public in more than one location. No source found since October 2023 gives a measured share of people with basic digital skills.
cells.note: The youth ministry signed for a national programme for 40,000 young people in June 2026, and the education ministry joined the DiGi school project in May 2025. The counts held are a one-province pilot and incubator and an association's project, so not stage 3.
